title: El Brindis de Orizaba, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: brindis-orizaba (MAJESTIC): fiesta de compromiso en el jardín de una hacienda de Orizaba, Veracruz, de noche. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cinco se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.TOMAS_ARCE: Mexican man, 56 years old, tall and thin, tanned skin, slicked-back salt-and-pepper hair, a thin mustache, a white guayabera with fine embroidery, beige trousers, brown shoes, his hands empty.
chars.VALERIA_RIOS: Mexican woman, 28 years old, light-brown skin, long wavy dark-brown hair half up, natural makeup, small gold earrings, an elegant light-pink satin cocktail dress, nude heels, her hands empty.
chars.DIEGO_SALAS: Mexican man, 30 years old, fair skin, short neat black hair, clean-shaven, a navy-blue suit, a white shirt, a light-blue tie, black shoes, his hands empty.
chars.CLEMENTE_SALAS: Mexican regional boss from Veracruz, 65 years old, heavy-set, light skin, white hair, a white beard, a cream panama hat, a black linen jacket over a black shirt, a gold chain, his hands empty.
chars.MERCEDES_SALAS: Mexican woman, 60 years old, fair skin, voluminous dyed red hair, heavy makeup, big emerald earrings, an emerald-green sequined evening dress, a gold bracelet, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_JARDINORIZABA: Garden of an old hacienda in Orizaba, Veracruz, at night during an engagement party: string lights overhead, round tables with white tablecloths and white flowers, a long head table, crystal glasses, a small wooden stage with a microphone stand, tropical plants and a stone fountain, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
